title: I'd rather have the banana, please.
scene: 水果二选一，他坚持偏好。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Do you want an apple or a banana?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'd rather have the banana, please.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you already had a banana yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I know, but I like banana better.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You will get tired of them if you eat too many.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'm not tired of them yet, though.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Okay then, banana it is for you.
